title: Typical Architecture of a Classification Neural Network (Overview)

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: In the last video, we saw some examples classification inputs and outputs.
cues.zh: 上一部影片，我們看了一些分類輸入與輸出的例子。

cues.en: The main takeaway that the inputs to a classification model, particularly in neural network, want to be some form of numerical representation, and the outputs are often some form of prediction probability.
cues.zh: 重點是分類模型，尤其神經網路，輸入要是某種數值表示，而輸出通常是某種預測機率。

cues.en: So let's discuss the typical architecture of a classification model.
cues.zh: 現在討論分類模型的典型架構。

cues.en: And hey, this is just going to be text on a page, but we're going to be building a fair few of these.
cues.zh: 目前只是頁面上的文字，不過我們會建立好幾個這樣的模型。

cues.en: So we've got some hyper parameters over here.
cues.zh: 這裡有一些超參數。

cues.en: We've got binary classification and we've got multiclass classification.
cues.zh: 有二元分類，也有多類別分類。

cues.en: Now, there are some similarities between the two in terms of what problem we're working with, but there also are some differences here.
cues.zh: 就處理的問題而言，兩者有相似之處，但這裡也有一些差異。

cues.en: And by the way, this is all come from if we go to the book version of the course we've got what is a classification problem and we've got architecture of a classification neural network.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這些內容全都來自課程的書籍版本，有「什麼是分類問題」以及「分類神經網路的架構」。

cues.en: So all of this text is available at Lone Pine Audio and in Section two.
cues.zh: 所有這些文字都在 learnpytorch.io 的第二章。

cues.en: So we come back.
cues.zh: 回到這裡。

cues.en: So the input layer shape, which is typically decided by the parameter in features, as you can see here, is the same of number of features.
cues.zh: 輸入層的形狀，通常由 in_features 參數決定，如這裡所示，等於特徵數。

cues.en: So if we were working on a problem such as we wanted to predict whether someone had heart disease or not, we might have five input features such as one for age, a number for age.
cues.zh: 例如要預測一個人有沒有心臟病，可能有五個輸入特徵，像年齡，用數字表示年齡。

cues.en: It might be, in my case, 28.
cues.zh: 以我為例，可能是 28。

cues.en: Sex could be male, height 180 centimetres.
cues.zh: 性別可能是男性，身高 180 公分。

cues.en: If I've been growing overnight, it's really closer to 177.
cues.zh: 如果我晚上偷偷長高的話，其實更接近 177。

cues.en: Wait.
cues.zh: 體重，

cues.en: Well, it depends on how much I've eaten, but it's around about 75 kilos and smoking status, which is zero.
cues.zh: 取決於吃了多少，不過大約 75 公斤，還有吸菸狀態，是 0。

cues.en: So it could be zero or one because remember, we want numerical representation.
cues.zh: 可以是 0 或 1，記得要用數值表示。

cues.en: So for sex it could be zero for males, one for female height could be its number, weight could be its number as well.
cues.zh: 性別可以用 0 表示男性，1 表示女性；身高可以用它的數字，體重也用它的數字。

cues.en: All of these numbers could be more, could be less as well.
cues.zh: 這些數字也可能更多或更少。

cues.en: So this is really flexible and it's a hyper parameter y because we decide the values for each of these.
cues.zh: 所以很有彈性，而它是超參數，因為這些值由我們決定。

cues.en: So in the case of our image prediction problem we could have in features equals three for number of colour channels and then we go hidden layers.
cues.zh: 在圖片預測問題中，in_features 可以等於 3，表示色彩通道數；接著是隱藏層。

cues.en: So there's the blue circle here.
cues.zh: 這裡的藍色圓圈。

cues.en: I forgot that this was all timed and colourful, but let's just discuss hidden layers.
cues.zh: 我忘了這些都設定好動畫與顏色，不過先討論隱藏層。

cues.en: Each of these is a layer and end up linear and end dot linear and end up réélu and then dot linear.
cues.zh: 這裡每個都是一層，nn.Linear、nn.Linear、nn.ReLU、nn.Linear。

cues.en: So that's the kind of the syntax you'll see in pie, which for a layer is not something.
cues.zh: 所以在 PyTorch 中，層的語法通常就是 nn.某個名稱。

cues.en: Now there are many different types of layers in this, in PyTorch if we go torch and n.
cues.zh: PyTorch 有許多不同類型的層，看看 torch.nn。

cues.en: Basically everything in here is a layer and a neural network.
cues.zh: 這裡基本上都是神經網路中的層。

cues.en: And then if we look at what a neural network looks like.
cues.zh: 再看看神經網路長什麼樣。

cues.en: Neural network.
cues.zh: 神經網路。

cues.en: Recall that all of these are different layers of some kind of mathematical operation, input layer, hidden layer.
cues.zh: 記得這些都是某種數學運算的不同層，輸入層、隱藏層。

cues.en: You could have as many hidden layers as you want.
cues.zh: 隱藏層要有多少都可以。

cues.en: Do we have raised net architecture?
cues.zh: 有 ResNet 架構嗎？

cues.en: The resonate architecture.
cues.zh: ResNet 架構。

cues.en: Some of them have 50 layers.
cues.zh: 有些有 50 層。

cues.en: Look at this.
cues.zh: 看看這個。

cues.en: Each one of these is a layer.
cues.zh: 這裡每一個都是一層。

cues.en: And this is only the 34 layer version.
cues.zh: 而這還只是 34 層的版本。

cues.en: I mean, there's resin at 152, which is 152 layers.
cues.zh: 還有 ResNet-152，也就是 152 層。

cues.en: We're not at that yet, but we're working up the tools to get to that stage.
cues.zh: 我們還沒到那裡，不過正在建立到那個階段所需的工具。

cues.en: Let's come back to heal the neurons per head and layer.
cues.zh: 回來看，每個隱藏層的神經元數量。

cues.en: So we've got these out features, the green circle, the green square.
cues.zh: 這裡是 out_features，綠色圓圈，或者說綠色方框。

cues.en: Now this is if we go back to our neural network picture, this is these each one of these little things is a neuron, some sort of parameter.
cues.zh: 回到神經網路的圖片，這裡每個小東西都是一個神經元，某種參數。

cues.en: So if we had 100, what would that look like?
cues.zh: 如果有 100 個，看起來如何？

cues.en: Well, we'd have a fairly big graphic.
cues.zh: 圖就會相當大。

cues.en: So this is why I like to teach with code, because you could customize this as flexible as you want.
cues.zh: 所以我喜歡用程式來教，因為你可以自由調整。

cues.en: So behind the scenes, PyTorch is going to create 100 of these little circles for us.
cues.zh: 在幕後，PyTorch 會替我們建立 100 個這樣的小圓圈。

cues.en: And within each circle is what, some sort of mathematical operation.
cues.zh: 而每個圓圈裡面是什麼？某種數學運算。

cues.en: So if we come back, what do we got next?
cues.zh: 回來，接著是什麼？

cues.en: Output layer, shape.
cues.zh: 輸出層的形狀。

cues.en: So this is how many output features we have.
cues.zh: 也就是輸出特徵的數量。

cues.en: So in the case of binary classification is one, one class or the other.
cues.zh: 二元分類的情況是 1，一個類別或另一個。

cues.en: We're going to see this later on.
cues.zh: 稍後會看到。

cues.en: Multiclass classification as you might have three output features, one per class, e.g. one for food, person or dog.
cues.zh: 多類別分類可能有三個輸出特徵，每個類別一個，例如食物、人或狗，

cues.en: If you are building a food person or dog image classification model.
cues.zh: 假設你要建立食物、人或狗的圖片分類模型。

cues.en: Hidden layer activation, which is we haven't seen these yet.
cues.zh: 隱藏層的激活函數，我們還沒看過。

cues.en: Reller which is a rectified linear unit but can be many others because PyTorch, of course, has what has a lot of non-linear activations.
cues.zh: ReLU，也就是修正線性單元；也可以用其他很多種，因為 PyTorch 當然提供了許多非線性激活函數。

cues.en: We're going to see this later on.
cues.zh: 稍後會看到。

cues.en: Remember, I'm kind of planting the seed here.
cues.zh: 記得，我現在只是先種下這個概念。

cues.en: We've seen what a linear line is, but I want you to imagine what a non-linear line is.
cues.zh: 我們看過線性的線，不過請想像一下非線性的線。

cues.en: It's going to be a bit of a super power for our classification problem.
cues.zh: 它會成為分類問題中的一種超能力。

cues.en: What else do we have?
cues.zh: 還有什麼？

cues.en: Output activation.
cues.zh: 輸出的激活函數。

cues.en: We haven't got that here, but we'll also see this later on, which could be sigmoid four, which is generally sigmoid for binary classification, but soft max for multiclass classification.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有列出，不過之後會看到，例如 sigmoid，二元分類通常使用 sigmoid，多類別分類則使用 softmax。

cues.en: A lot of these things are just names on a page.
cues.zh: 這些很多都還只是頁面上的名稱。

cues.en: We haven't seen them yet.
cues.zh: 我們還沒看過。

cues.en: I like to teach them as we see them, but this is just a general overview of what we're going to cover.
cues.zh: 我喜歡實際遇到時再教，不過這裡先概覽接下來會涵蓋的內容。

cues.en: Loss function.
cues.zh: 損失函數。

cues.en: What loss function or what does a loss function do?
cues.zh: 哪種損失函數？或者說損失函數做什麼？

cues.en: It measures how wrong our model's predictions are compared to what the ideal predictions are.
cues.zh: 衡量模型預測與理想預測相比，有多不準。

cues.en: So for binary classification, we might use binary cross entropy loss in PyTorch, and for multiclass classification we might just use cross entropy rather than binary cross entropy.
cues.zh: 二元分類可能使用 PyTorch 的二元交叉熵損失；多類別分類則可能只用交叉熵，不是二元交叉熵。

cues.en: Get it binary classification, binary cross entropy and then optimize that.
cues.zh: 明白吧？二元分類，二元交叉熵。再來是最佳化器。

cues.en: SGD Stochastic gradient descent.
cues.zh: SGD，隨機梯度下降。

cues.en: We've seen that one before.
cues.zh: 這個我們看過。

cues.en: Another common option is the Atom optimizer.
cues.zh: 另一個常見選擇是 Adam 最佳化器。

cues.en: And of course the torch dropped in package has plenty more options.
cues.zh: 當然，torch.optim 套件還提供許多其他選項。

cues.en: So this is an example multiclass classification problem, this network here.
cues.zh: 這個網路是多類別分類問題的例子。

cues.en: Why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: And we haven't actually seen any sequential, but as you could imagine, sequential stands for.
cues.zh: 我們還沒看過 nn.Sequential，不過應該猜得到 sequential 表示什麼。

cues.en: It just goes through each of these steps.
cues.zh: 就是依序執行這些步驟。

cues.en: So multiclass classification because it has three output features, more than one thing or another.
cues.zh: 這是多類別分類，因為有三個輸出特徵，不只是一種或另一種。

cues.en: So three for food, person or dog.
cues.zh: 三個代表食物、人或狗。

cues.en: But going back to our food vision problem, we could have the input as sushi steak.
cues.zh: 不過回到 Food Vision，也可以輸入壽司、牛排

cues.en: Or pizza.
cues.zh: 或披薩。

cues.en: So we've got three output features, which would be one prediction probability per class of image.
cues.zh: 所以有三個輸出特徵，每個圖片類別都有一個預測機率。

cues.en: We have three classes, sushi, steak or pizza.
cues.zh: 有三個類別，壽司、牛排或披薩。

cues.en: Now, I think we've done enough talking here and enough just pointing to text on slides.
cues.zh: 我想這裡已經講得夠多，也對投影片上的文字指指點點夠久了。

cues.en: How about in the next video?
cues.zh: 下一部影片，

cues.zh: 來寫程式吧。
